summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation to report a distribution to certificate holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-4, an asset-backed security trust. The filing provides details of the June 15, 2026 interest distribution, including $275,625 in interest received and $5.39093 per certificate. It includes boilerplate disclaimers regarding the registrant's lack of involvement in underlying issuers' reporting. There are no terms of a transaction, no change of control, no activist campaign, no strategic review, and no special situation event. This is a standard periodic distribution report for a securitization vehicle.
